jerome-etienne--punch-doom.exercise_en: Build camera frame differencing in p5.js so the monster gets knocked flying when a big motion is detected in a certain region of the frame. Twist: the monster dodges, so you have to punch from different directions.

disney-research-ar--revel.description_zh: Olivier Bau 和 Ivan Poupyrev 提出的反向电振动技术，向用户身体注入一个微弱信号，让真实表面上投影或 AR 呈现的虚拟物体拥有可以触摸到的纹理。
disney-research-ar--revel.idea_en: Send a faint signal through the body so projected virtual objects have texture you can feel.
disney-research-ar--revel.technique_zh: 反向电振动向用户身体注入微弱的时变电信号，在滑动的手指与任意接地的导电表面之间产生振荡的静电吸引力，被感知为纹理，并可针对每个虚拟物体分别调制。
disney-research-ar--revel.exercise_en: Simulate tactile textures in AR with phone vibration (the Vibration API or Unity Handheld.Vibrate): play vibrations of different frequencies and rhythms as a finger slides over different virtual objects (REVEL's electrical stimulation is not suitable to reproduce in class). Twist: have classmates close their eyes and guess the material from the vibration alone.

random-international--rain-room.description_zh: 一片 100 平方米、持续降落的水幕，人走到哪里，哪里的雨就会停下，观众得以在雨中穿行而不被淋湿。
random-international--rain-room.idea_en: Walk through rain that stops just for you.
random-international--rain-room.technique_zh: 3D 相机从上方追踪观众，由电磁阀组成的网格实时关闭每个人周围那几块区域的水流。
random-international--rain-room.exercise_en: Make "virtual rain" with an overhead camera and floor projection, so raindrops automatically avoid the area around each person. Twist: build a one-meter-square physical prototype with solenoid valves or a small water pump.

novarama--reality-fighters.description_zh: PS Vita 的首发游戏之一：玩家把自己拍下的脸贴到格斗角色身上，在 Vita 后置摄像头拍到的真实环境中进行 AR 对打。
novarama--reality-fighters.idea_en: Put your own face on a fighter and brawl in AR in a real street or living room.
novarama--reality-fighters.technique_zh: 把拍下的人脸映射到格斗角色的头部，角色以 AR 卡片为锚点，渲染在后置摄像头的画面之上。
novarama--reality-fighters.exercise_en: Take a photo of your face with the front camera, paste it onto the head of a tiny AR fighter, and fight a classmate's fighter on the table. Twist: the loser's face texture shows "scars".

moment-factory--sagrada-familia.description_zh: 在梅尔塞节（La Mercè）期间，于高迪的圣家堂立面上上演的一场宏大投影映射秀，让石墙看起来在生长、涌流、开花。
moment-factory--sagrada-familia.idea_en: A projection show that makes the stone walls of the Sagrada Família grow, flood and bloom.
moment-factory--sagrada-familia.technique_zh: 采用多投影仪边缘融合的大型建筑投影映射，借助精细的立面三维模型渲染生长与水流效果，并与其浮雕起伏精确贴合。
moment-factory--sagrada-familia.exercise_en: Project onto an object with relief or a complex surface (a plaster bust, a carved box) so its surface seems to grow, flood or bloom. Twist: express an emotion from the object's "inner life".

valentin-heun--second-surface.description_zh: Shunichi Kasahara、Valentin Heun 和 Austin Lee 让多人通过平板在身边的真实表面上画画、留言，这些涂鸦会固定在空间中，供其他人看到。
valentin-heun--second-surface.idea_en: Several people doodle and leave notes on real surfaces, and the notes stay put for others to find.
valentin-heun--second-surface.technique_zh: 对表面纹理进行自然特征追踪，为每台平板计算相对于同一实体表面的 6DOF 位姿；笔画以表面坐标存储并通过网络共享，从每个视角都能正确渲染。
valentin-heun--second-surface.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation shared anchors (or the same image target) so two phones see the same wall, then draw and leave messages on it that sync in real time. Twist: messages only appear at a certain time or when a certain person comes near.

theo-watson--skataviz.description_zh: 把一部 iPhone 固定在滑板上记录运动，并把滑板的旋转和花式动作以三维数据的形式可视化，叠加在滑行过程的实拍视频上。
theo-watson--skataviz.idea_en: Strap a phone to a skateboard and turn board flips into 3D data trails over the video.
theo-watson--skataviz.technique_zh: 对手机的陀螺仪和加速度计进行融合（IMU 传感器融合），得到姿态数据流，驱动三维滑板模型和数据轨迹，并叠加在同步的视频上。
theo-watson--skataviz.exercise_en: Strap a phone to a skateboard, bicycle or basketball, use the DeviceOrientation API in a web page to record its rotation, and overlay a 3D trail on the video. Twist: visualize the data as an animal that "calls out" when a trick happens.

columbia-feiner--snapar.description_zh: 在手持 AR 设备上从不同视角为场景拍下虚拟快照，之后无需来回走动，就能在这些视角之间即时切换。
columbia-feiner--snapar.idea_en: Take a few AR snapshots of a scene, then jump between viewpoints without walking around.
columbia-feiner--snapar.technique_zh: 手持设备把追踪到的相机图像连同位姿保存为快照，用户可以把显示画面切换到某张已存快照（并针对该位姿重新渲染实时 AR 叠加），而不必亲自走到那个位置。
columbia-feiner--snapar.exercise_en: Implement a "save viewpoint" button in AR Foundation that stores the current camera image and pose, so tapping a thumbnail later switches to that viewpoint to view the virtual objects. Twist: use these snapshots to make a multi-view "AR comparison sheet" that explains a piece of work.

nintendo--spirit-camera-the-cursed-memoi.description_zh: 与光荣特库摩（Koei Tecmo）共同开发的《零》系列外传：3DS 变成闹鬼的射影机，随游戏附赠的诅咒日记会让幽灵出现在你真实的房间里。
nintendo--spirit-camera-the-cursed-memoi.idea_en: The 3DS becomes a camera that can photograph ghosts, and the bundled diary reveals them in AR.
nintendo--spirit-camera-the-cursed-memoi.technique_zh: 印刷小册子的各页作为图像目标触发剧情事件，同时基于陀螺仪的瞄准让幽灵出现在摄像头画面中玩家的四周。
nintendo--spirit-camera-the-cursed-memoi.exercise_en: Make a paper "cursed diary" of a few pages, where scanning each page triggers an AR ghost or a sound. Twist: the ghosts can only be seen with the lights off (when camera brightness is low).

mit-tangible-media--tether.description_zh: 具备空间感知能力的平板充当观看桌面上方共享三维场景的窗口；多位用户在屏幕后方用手势雕塑虚拟物体并制作动画。
mit-tangible-media--tether.idea_en: Several people use tablets as windows and shape and animate 3D objects by hand in a shared space above a table.
mit-tangible-media--tether.technique_zh: Vicon 动作捕捉追踪每台 iPad 和用户戴手套的手，使每台平板都能渲染出进入共享三维场景的正确透视画面，屏幕后方的手部位置则用来操控虚拟物体。
mit-tangible-media--tether.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation shared anchors so two or three phones see the same virtual sculpture, each acting as a "window" from a different angle, and pinch vertices by tapping and dragging. Twist: each phone can only see or edit part of the sculpture, so finishing it takes teamwork.

chris-milk--the-treachery-of-sanctuary.description_zh: 由三块白色屏幕组成的三联作品：在第一块屏幕上，观众的影子碎裂成四散飞走的鸟；在第二块上，群鸟把影子啄食殆尽；在第三块上，影子长出巨大的翅膀，腾空而起。
chris-milk--the-treachery-of-sanctuary.idea_en: Across three screens your shadow falls apart, is devoured, then grows wings and flies.
chris-milk--the-treachery-of-sanctuary.technique_zh: Kinect 深度相机捕捉每位观众的剪影和骨架，采用类似 openFrameworks/Unity 的实时图形，把影子的局部替换成动画飞鸟和翅膀，投影在屏幕上。
chris-milk--the-treachery-of-sanctuary.exercise_en: Get the arm skeleton from MediaPipe Pose and grow a pair of wings on the silhouette that flap with the arms. Twist: design your own "three acts", giving the shadow a different fate in each.

ivan-poupyrev--touche.description_zh: 一种扫频电容感应技术，只用一个电极就能识别你触碰门把手、桌子、水或自己身体的方式，比如是用两指一捏还是整只手握住。
ivan-poupyrev--touche.idea_en: A single electrode can tell whether you pinch, grasp, or plunge your whole hand into water.
ivan-poupyrev--touche.technique_zh: 在一段频率范围内扫描激励频率，并对得到的电容曲线进行分类，因为不同的握法会在不同频率下改变人体阻抗。
ivan-poupyrev--touche.exercise_en: Connect a water glass, a piece of fruit or a doorknob to a Makey Makey or an Arduino's capacitive touch pin, and train a simple classifier to tell "a touch" from "a grip". Twist: map the different grips to different effects in phone AR.

sce-london-studio--wonderbook-book-of-sp.description_zh: 与 J.K. 罗琳的 Pottermore 合作撰写：一本印有标记的空白书在屏幕上变成立体弹出式咒语书，玩家把 Move 手柄当作魔杖挥动施咒，影响书页和房间。
sce-london-studio--wonderbook-book-of-sp.idea_en: A blank physical book turns into a pop-up spellbook on screen, with the controller as your wand.
sce-london-studio--wonderbook-book-of-sp.technique_zh: 书的每一页都印有不同的标记，页面的身份和位姿决定渲染哪个弹出式场景，被追踪的 Move 魔杖手势则向场景中施放咒语。
sce-london-studio--wonderbook-book-of-sp.exercise_en: Put a different image marker on each page of a small booklet so turning the page pops up a matching 3D scene in AR. Twist: use the phone as a wand, waving it above the page to trigger changes.

pablo-valbuena--re-flex.description_zh: 为 Z33 创作的投影光装置，揭示并扭曲了房间的几何结构，片中由艺术家本人讲解。
pablo-valbuena--re-flex.idea_en: An installation where light reveals and warps the geometry of a room.
pablo-valbuena--re-flex.technique_zh: 与房间几何结构标定对齐的投影光线，通过从选定视点出发的变形透视对位，揭示或颠覆房间原有的透视关系。
pablo-valbuena--re-flex.exercise_en: Project a set of lines in a small room that only join into a complete figure from one position (anamorphic perspective) and look like fragments from anywhere else. Twist: mark a wrong viewing spot on the floor and let the audience find the right one themselves.

nintendo--ar-games-nintendo-3ds.description_zh: 每台 3DS 都预装的游戏：把一张“?”AR 卡片放在桌上，就会有巨龙从中破出，你还可以在桌面裂开的湖里钓鱼、射箭打靶、随手涂鸦。
nintendo--ar-games-nintendo-3ds.idea_en: Put an AR card on the table and the tabletop cracks open into a lake or a dragon bursts out.
nintendo--ar-games-nintendo-3ds.technique_zh: 一张已知图案的印刷卡片作为基准标记提供相机位姿，裸眼立体 3D 屏幕则渲染从卡片周围桌面平面中冒出的内容。
nintendo--ar-games-nintendo-3ds.exercise_en: Use a printed image marker to make an AR dragon that bursts "cracking" out of the tabletop, using a stencil to cut the hole in the table. Twist: put the marker on different surfaces and have the dragon react differently.

nintendo--ar-games-fishing.description_zh: 3DS 的 AR Games 模式之一：AR 卡片周围的桌面变成一片池塘，玩家通过移动和倾斜掌机来钓鱼。
nintendo--ar-games-fishing.idea_en: The tabletop turns into a pond in AR, and moving the handheld lets you fish at your own desk.
nintendo--ar-games-fishing.technique_zh: 卡片借助模板（stencil）或深度遮罩把桌面标记为水面，掌机的倾斜和移动被映射为鱼线和收线动作。
nintendo--ar-games-fishing.exercise_en: Make a "water surface" on the table with a shader, tilt the phone to cast, and lift it quickly to reel in. Twist: fish only bite when you stay quiet (judged by the microphone).

columbia-feiner--psychomotor-ar.description_zh: 头戴式 AR 直接在真实的发动机燃烧室上显示动画引导，指导装配任务中需要动手操作的环节（对准和插入零件）。
columbia-feiner--psychomotor-ar.idea_en: AR animation demonstrates how your hands should move, right on the real part.
columbia-feiner--psychomotor-ar.technique_zh: 对燃烧室零件进行 6DOF 追踪，动画叠加层比较零件当前位姿与目标位姿，持续显示对准提示（箭头、旋转提示），直到零件被正确插入。
columbia-feiner--psychomotor-ar.exercise_en: Use image tracking on a LEGO baseplate and a part with a sticker, and show a ghost of the target position in AR that turns greener as the part gets closer. Twist: remove the visual hints and guide the alignment with sound alone.

chris-oshea--body-swap.description_zh: 两个人并排站立，各自像操纵木偶一样控制屏幕上对方的身体，让对方跳舞、蹦跳、出洋相。
chris-oshea--body-swap.idea_en: Swap bodies with the person beside you: you control their on-screen figure while they control yours.
chris-oshea--body-swap.technique_zh: Kinect 骨架追踪两名玩家，驱动屏幕上的两个木偶，每位玩家的关节数据都被映射到对方的化身上。
chris-oshea--body-swap.exercise_en: Track two people at once with MediaPipe Pose and render A's movements on B's silhouette puppet and vice versa. Twist: swap only half the body, for example you control the other person's legs and they control your arms, to complete a shared task.

keiichi-matsuda--cell.description_zh: 一件互动装置：深度相机追踪观众，在一面大型镜面屏幕上把取自社交媒体的身份标签附着在他们身上，随人漂浮。
keiichi-matsuda--cell.idea_en: A digital mirror that tracks bodies and slaps online identity tags on every passerby in real time.
keiichi-matsuda--cell.technique_zh: Kinect 深度相机对每位观众进行分割并追踪其骨架，openFrameworks 渲染文字标签，使其在镜面般的屏幕上跟随被追踪的头部或躯干位置。
keiichi-matsuda--cell.exercise_en: Track several people in a webcam feed with MediaPipe Pose on a web page and stick randomly scraped online tags (hashtags, nicknames, ad slogans) above each person's head. Twist: make the tags change with a person's stance or how long they stay, and discuss "how algorithms label you".

tamiko-thiel--carnation-rain.description_zh: 在里斯本卡尔穆广场（Largo do Carmo）上空降下一场红色康乃馨的 AR 花雨，1974 年的康乃馨革命正是在这里落幕。
tamiko-thiel--carnation-rain.idea_en: An AR rain of carnations falls over the square where the revolution took place.
tamiko-thiel--carnation-rain.technique_zh: 把一个以 GPS 锚定、类似粒子效果的对象（下落的花朵动画）放置在这座历史广场上空，以地理位置作为历史意义的载体。
tamiko-thiel--carnation-rain.exercise_en: Pick a campus or city location tied to a historical event and use Unity AR to make objects related to that event fall from the sky. Twist: use a particle system so the fallen objects slowly pile up on the ground into a symbol.

zach-lieberman--chase-no-face-bell.description_zh: 一支音乐录影带：利用破解的 Kinect、面部追踪器和 LED 投影仪，把图形实时投射到歌手 BELL 的脸上，全程没有后期制作。
zach-lieberman--chase-no-face-bell.idea_en: Every graphic on the faces in this music video was projected live, with no post-production.
zach-lieberman--chase-no-face-bell.technique_zh: Kinect 提供深度数据用于估计头部姿态，二维 FaceTracker 拟合面部特征点，经过标定的投影仪实时把纹理渲染到歌手脸上；相机与投影仪已完成配准，因此无需后期。
zach-lieberman--chase-no-face-bell.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Face Mesh and a projector to make a live face-projection music video for a 30-second song, shot in one continuous take. Twist: switch to a different face "skin" for each line of lyrics, with the style decided by team members drawing lots.

klaus-obermaier--dancing-house.description_zh: 在历史建筑立面上进行的互动投影映射：建筑会随着站在它面前的人的动作弯曲、摇摆、“跳舞”。
klaus-obermaier--dancing-house.idea_en: When you move, the whole old building twists and dances with you.
klaus-obermaier--dancing-house.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪观众的身体动作，将其映射为立面三维模型的形变参数，再把该模型投影映射到建筑上。
klaus-obermaier--dancing-house.exercise_en: Photograph and model a wall or a cardboard building, and use body pose (such as MediaPipe Pose) to bend the projected texture. Twist: when two people make opposite moves at the same time, the building "tears".

chris-oshea--dash-dodge-dive.description_zh: 为 2012 年伦敦奥运会大屏幕设计的群体游戏：英国各地公共广场上的人们，通过大屏幕摄像头捕捉的身体动作彼此比拼。
chris-oshea--dash-dodge-dive.idea_en: Big screens in squares across the UK are linked so crowds battle other cities with their bodies.
chris-oshea--dash-dodge-dive.technique_zh: 大屏幕上的摄像头通过运动检测（帧差或斑点追踪）按区域测量人群的运动量，分数通过网络在各个地点之间同步。
chris-oshea--dash-dodge-dive.exercise_en: Split the camera image into left and right zones in p5.js, measure the amount of motion in each as the two teams' "strength", and play a projected tug-of-war. Twist: two classrooms compete over the network, and the winners get to leave a message on the other side's screen.

hellicar-and-lewis--divide-by-zero.description_zh: 一部舞蹈影片：表演者在催眠师的引导下起舞，她的动作驱动互动图形，把潜意识内容与数字界面联系在一起。
hellicar-and-lewis--divide-by-zero.idea_en: A dance under hypnotic guidance turns unconscious movement into a visible interface.
hellicar-and-lewis--divide-by-zero.technique_zh: 通过摄像头追踪舞者，驱动围绕她身体合成的实时生成图形（大概率使用 openFrameworks）。
hellicar-and-lewis--divide-by-zero.exercise_en: Have a classmate close their eyes and improvise movement while listening to a guided script, as a camera draws their motion trail as lines. Twist: afterward, let them watch the playback and write down their reading of the "subconscious graphics".

sce-london-studio--eyepet-friends.description_zh: 两位玩家可以各养一只宠物，让它们在客厅里一起玩耍，还加入了新的服装、绘画和小游戏模式。
sce-london-studio--eyepet-friends.idea_en: Two AR pets play together in your living room.
sce-london-studio--eyepet-friends.technique_zh: 两个被追踪的手柄和两只宠物实例共享基于摄像头的地面坐标系，让两位玩家的宠物能在同一段增强视频中互动。
sce-london-studio--eyepet-friends.exercise_en: Put two pets in the same AR view, each controlled by a different player, and have them interact based on their distance. Twist: give each pet its own personality so the two come into conflict.
